en: The Triplet on the Wholesome (Kusalattika), The Dyad on Mental Factors (Cetasikaduka)
Dependent on a wholesome mental state, a non-wholesome non-mental state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a wholesome mental state, a non-unwholesome non-mental state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a wholesome mental state, a non-indeterminate non-mental state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a wholesome mental state, there arise non-unwholesome, non-mental states and non-indeterminate,
non-mental states by way of root condition. Dependent on a wholesome mental state, there arise non-wholesome,
non-mental states and non-unwholesome, non-mental states by way of root condition … five.
Dependent on an unwholesome mental state, a non-unwholesome non-mental state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an unwholesome mental state, a non-wholesome non-mental state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on an unwholesome mental state, a non-indeterminate non-mental state arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on an unwholesome mental state, there arise states that are neither wholesome nor mental, and neither indeterminate nor mental, by way of root condition. Dependent on an unwholesome mental state,
there arise states that are neither wholesome nor mental, and neither unwholesome nor mental, by way of root condition … [five].
Dependent on an indeterminate mental state, an unwholesome non-mental state arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on an indeterminate mental state, an unwholesome non-mental state arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on an indeterminate mental state, both an unwholesome non-mental state and an unwholesome non-mental state arise by way of root-condition.
Phenomena arise with root-condition … three. (Abbreviated. Under root: thirteen;
under object: nine … pe … under resultant: three … pe … under non-disappearance: thirteen. Under non-mental: under root: nine … pe … under resultant: three … pe … under non-disappearance: nine.
